Name: Example: Party Modes
Description: Three new match modes built on Battle: INSTAGIB, HEADHUNTER and MOON BOUNCE. A copy-me starting point for mods that add game modes.
Author: Second Hunt

Modes.Name: INSTAGIB
Modes.Description: Every hit is a kill and you're back in a second. First to the point goal wins.

Modes.Name: HEADHUNTER
Modes.Description: A kill is worth 1 point, a headshot kill is worth 3. Aim high.

Modes.Name: MOON BOUNCE
Modes.Description: Low gravity and big jumps. Fight in the air.
